title: Goodbye Michael
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael prepares to leave Dunder Mifflin for Colorado to start a new life with Holly. The office organizes a farewell party with debates over cake and gifts. Michael shares personal moments with coworkers, including giving Dwight a letter of recommendation and revealing a secret about Phyllis. Conflicts arise as Deangelo and Gabe assert authority, and Andy struggles with losing a client. Michael's departure is marked by heartfelt goodbyes, including an emotional moment with Jim and Pam, before he leaves for the airport full of hope.
